_comment: mermaid-cli drives a headless Chromium through Puppeteer. Container and CI images run as root, where Chromium's sandbox refuses to start; --no-sandbox is what makes `build.py figures` work anywhere. It is safe here because the only thing the browser ever loads is a local .mmd file this repository wrote. Set PUPPETEER_EXECUTABLE_PATH to point mermaid-cli at a Chromium you already have instead of downloading one.
